domotic_dishTidyUp: A red robot arm is tidying up dishes on a table. A metal dish rack stands on the left. The robot picks up cups, a green whisk and green plates from the table, one at a time, and puts each of them into the rack. The cups stand in a row at the front of the rack, the whisk lies at the front of the rack, and each plate stands upright in a slot of the rack.
domotic_groceriesSorting: A red robot arm is sorting toy groceries. Two clear plastic boxes stand on the table: the left box has a pink sign and the right box has a yellow-green sign. Between them is a paper basket with toy food. The robot takes one item at a time from the basket. Fruits and vegetables, such as a banana, grapes, an apple or a pepper, go into the left box with the pink sign. Sweets, such as a chocolate bar, a waffle, a biscuit or a donut, go into the right box with the yellow-green sign.
domotic_makingCoffee: A red robot arm is making coffee. A white coffee machine with an open lid stands on the left, with a paper filter at its top and a glass jug below it. A coffee can with a spoon in it stands on the right. The robot takes the spoon, scoops coffee powder from the can, pours the powder into the paper filter at the top of the coffee machine, and puts the spoon back into the can.
domotic_pouringCoffee: A red robot arm is pouring coffee. A plastic jug with dark coffee and an empty glass stand on the table. The robot lifts the jug by its handle, pours coffee into the glass, and puts the jug back on the table. All the coffee should end up inside the glass or stay in the jug.
domotic_setTheTable: A red robot arm is setting the table. A metal dish rack stands on the left and a white cup holding cutlery stands on the right. The robot puts one green plate in the middle of the table, one glass in front of the plate, one orange knife to the left of the plate as seen in the image, and one pink fork to the right of the plate as seen in the image.
domotic_vegetablesAndFruitsSorting: A red robot arm is sorting toy fruits and vegetables. Two clear plastic boxes stand on the table: the left box has a pink mark and the right box has a yellow-green mark. Between them is a paper basket with the toys. The robot takes one item at a time from the basket. Fruits, such as a banana, grapes, an apple, a lemon, an orange or a strawberry, go into the left box with the pink mark. Vegetables, such as corn, broccoli, a pepper, a cucumber or lettuce, go into the right box with the yellow-green mark.
industrial_soldering: A red robot arm is soldering, seen from above. On a black perforated board there are a soldering iron, which is a long black pen-shaped tool with a cable, a metal spiral holder with a yellow sponge on the left, a small green electronic board in the middle, a reel of solder wire on the right, and a wooden block with the word KAPLA at the bottom right. The robot takes the soldering iron out of the spiral holder, touches the green electronic board with the tip of the iron, and puts the iron back into the spiral holder.
